items.title: Canadian airline hit by The Gentlemen ransomware
items.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group claimed an attack on a Canadian airline this month, according to Bitdefender's September threat debrief.

items.title: Moscone Center (ASM Global) listed on leak site
items.summary: San Francisco's Moscone Center, operated by ASM Global, was posted as a victim on Sep 22; the attack is estimated to have happened on Sep 11.

items.title: Rochester, NY beer distributor: 165 GB claimed
items.summary: A beer distributor in Rochester, New York was posted as a victim on Sep 22, with 165 GB of data claimed from an intrusion estimated at Sep 7.

items.title: Greg Jones & Associates, P.A. law firm claimed
items.summary: The law firm was posted as a victim on Sep 22, with the attack estimated to have happened on Sep 8.

items.title: Quantum Technology Marketing Group (Reading, UK) claimed
items.summary: The UK marketing firm was posted as a victim on Sep 22, with the intrusion estimated to have happened on Aug 13.

items.title: Ransomware attacks at a record high for 2026
items.summary: Industry tracking shows 2026 ransomware victim counts at record levels; Black Kite reports 7,551 victims, up 24.9% year over year.

ransomware.note: Most named victims this cycle come from leak-site postings on Sep 22; the victims have not confirmed them.

items.title: Azure East US outage takes down major AI services
items.summary: An Azure East US outage of about 90 minutes on Sep 3 disrupted ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and other dependent services during UK business hours.

items.title: Google Cloud incident cascades via Cloudflare to consumer apps
items.summary: A Google Cloud outage affected some Cloudflare services, and users reported disruptions at Spotify, Discord, Snapchat, Character.AI, Cursor and Replit.

items.title: AWS confirms permanent data loss in Bahrain region
items.summary: AWS confirmed that damage from the March conflict spanned multiple Availability Zones in me-south-1 and exceeded what its multi-AZ services are designed to withstand.

outage.note: No new hyperscaler outage surfaced in the past week; the items above are from earlier in September.

items.title: CISA adds 7 exploited flaws to KEV, including SonicWall SMA1000
items.summary: The additions cover Sangoma Switchvox, Kludex Starlette, Kestra OSS, BerriAI LiteLLM, JFrog Artifactory and two SonicWall SMA1000 bugs being used to drop reverse shells and crypto miners.

items.title: Chromium V8 type confusion CVE-2026-85046 added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added the actively exploited Google Chromium V8 type-confusion flaw; Chrome and Chromium-based browsers need patching.

items.title: Out-of-band Windows 11 update fixes two exploited zero-days
items.summary: KB5129194 for Windows 11 26H1 fixes CVE-2026-62721 and CVE-2026-85921 and should be deployed before October Patch Tuesday.

items.title: 11 new exploited CVEs this week; 1,333 non-Microsoft KEVs tracked
items.summary: Senserva counts 11 new exploited CVEs this week and tracks 1,333 exploited non-Microsoft CVEs across 282 vendors, 244 of them tied to ransomware.

items.title: SharePoint RCE CVE-2026-58644 remains a priority KEV
items.summary: An exploited SharePoint remote-code-execution zero-day added to KEV in July; on-prem SharePoint estates should confirm patch and hunting status.

items.title: Typhoon Dujuan: 12 dead, record rain in eastern Japan
items.summary: Flooding and landslides hit eastern Japan on Sep 21-22; as of Sep 24 the FDMA reported 12 dead and 3 missing.

items.title: Hurricane Polo reaches Category 5 off Guerrero, Mexico
items.summary: Polo reached 180 mph while nearly stationary about 215 miles south of Zihuatanejo, and the NHC warned of up to 12 inches of rain and mudslides in Guerrero and Michoacán.

items.title: US wildfire preparedness at Level 3, 33 large fires uncontained
items.summary: NIFC reports 95 incidents, 33 uncontained large fires covering about 1.97M acres, and 10,289 personnel assigned.

items.title: Tropical Storm Fay weakens in the Atlantic
items.summary: Fay peaked at 70 mph without reaching hurricane strength and has weakened to 40 mph, with no hazards to land.

items.title: M 6.4 earthquake near Kainantu, Papua New Guinea
items.summary: A M6.4 quake struck 49 km NNE of Kainantu on Sep 20, with a USGS green alert and no tsunami.

physical.note: Watch Polo's track toward the Mexican Pacific coast over the next 48 hours.
